name: YbCaF2
info: Design by Martin Beyer, 2025. Measured by the manufacturer Laseroptik GmbH in Garbsen (Germany). HT1015-1045nm coating @ 30deg, backside: AR 1015-1045nm coating @ 27-33deg, s-pol, FS-LO-U, diameter25x3mm, wedged, Coating batch number: 05095Th1, total number of samples: 20 (3 boxes with 6, one box with 2). Used named during development: YbCaF2_Garbsen_251014_Messung. Experiments verified a low damage threshold of about 100mJ/cm2.
